text: The new unobtrusive case runs without Carol's key and then with it. The first pass changes the shared test object's sig to false and flags to null. The key-present branch imports the key but does not restore either field, so its expectedResultCount stays zero and its signed, key-ID and flag checks remain skipped. The same code remains at the fixed accepted revision. This is a static test-coverage limit, not a reproduced failure or cryptographic result.
title: The unobtrusive-key subtest keeps zero signature expectations after importing the key
